items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: In that band, Raymond Scott and Webster had black and white -- they had Charlie Shavers playing trumpet... During this period of time, Charlie Shavers who apparently -- we had just worked together for the first time

ctx.x: Well, he arranged, but he never appeared as a musician.
No. No, no black musicians -- Charlie Shavers was the first black musician Tommy ever hired.
Right. And was he hired after Benny Goodman had hired Teddy Wilson?

items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: he and Charlie Shaver, they almost blew Charlie Barnet 's 16 pieces

ctx.x: O'Niel Spencer -- who fed them double time -- the thing with the fast wrists, and he and Charlie Shaver, they almost blew Charlie Barnet 's 16 pieces -- we had four trombones, and four or five trumpets then, and you should have heard them out swing us at certain points.
